plans.idea: Classic banner read left-to-right: the bottle anchors the left edge at full height, then one shared left edge on the right carries the logo, a big headline, and a full-width row of flavour pills underneath.

Centred brand axis: the logo sits as a quiet sign-off on the far left, the headline and pill row stack centred in the middle, and the bottle closes the right edge, so the product and the message bracket the copy.

Editorial left-aligned block: logo, headline and a wide pill row share one strong left margin, set apart by generous gaps, while the bottle stands on the right next to open space so the copy stays the main focus.
